dct_title_s: Myanmar Earthquakes: Damage Proxy Maps, Interferograms and Pixel Offset Maps, Mar 2025
dct_description_sm: # Myanmar Earthquakes: Damage Proxy Maps, Interferograms and Pixel Offset Maps, Mar 2025 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps, interferograms and pixel offset maps for Myanmar Earthquakes (Mar 2025) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Naypyidaw Vicinity, Myanmar, Earthquakes, 05 Apr 2025, v0.9 ** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Myanmar, Earthquakes, 5 Apr 2025, v0.9 ** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Myanmar, Earthquakes, 3 Apr 2025, v0.9 ** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Myanmar, Earthquakes, 3 Apr 2025, v0.5 ** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Naypyidaw Vicinity, Myanmar, Earthquakes, 31 Mar 2025, v0.9 ** - **EOS-RS Pixel Offset Map (Sentinel-2 Data): Myanmar, Earthquakes, Pre-Event: 2025/03/25-27 NORTHING** - **EOS-RS Interferogram (Unwrapped): Myanmar, Earthquakes, 2025/02/16-2025/03/30, v0.1** - **EOS-RS Interferogram (Wrapped): Myanmar, Earthquakes, 2025/02/16-2025/03/30, v0.1** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2024-2025)
